The user wants me to answer where the Eiffel Tower is, in JSON format with keys "city" and "country". The system prompt says to output a valid JSON object and use ``` to end the code block.

The Eiffel Tower is in Paris, France.

So the JSON should be:
{
  "city": "Paris",
  "country": "France"
}

And I should end with ``` to close the code block. The instruction says "Ensure to always use "```" End the code block to indicate the end of the JSON object." So I should wrap the JSON in a code block.
